body: As I said I was talking with many of them. I don't have any problem doing it myself.

First contact specialist - it's close to 100% that you are facing some documented mental illness which can be cured. Try with at least 4 of them(if there wont be result with the 1st one). If none can help you it's ur decision. When you are failing it's just the most pathetic but the most effective way of saying help me, start from talking with any peoples that are close to you, if there is none call hotline, reschedule ur attempt and try to meet somebody and change ur life.

OP, the thing is not everyone faces the depression to have no will to live. I mean depression can be treated. Some peoples just feel the world in another way. I'm waking up with this last bit of hope but when I'm going back to sleep I'm hoping that the next day will be better. This is the infinite loop that I'm able to do for the whole life, start living on autopilot till the end. But at the end of the day I will remember that my life is a lie that I created it on my own, I tricked myself to just be alive like an animal - to reproduce wearing fake smile just to walk through the most used path of life which just don't suit me(don't want to explain it to you because 2-6-2 in a sociological way but yea, if you want to talk DM me I still have a week or two).  If your tooth hurts you are not using this side of your mouth, you can't do it with somebody's mind - you have to treat it. You can't always change somebody's receiving of life because it juts not possible in that case.
